data.name: Hakimah
data.gender_notes: Hakimah is used as a unisex name in Islamic naming traditions.
data.long_meaning: Hakimah is an Arabic female name which means 'wise' or 'judge'. It is derived from the word 'hakim' which means 'wise' or 'judge'. In Islamic tradition, Hakimah is a title given to a wise and knowledgeable woman. The name Hakimah carries the meaning “Wise, Judge” and is chosen by families in Islamic traditions for the positive qualities it expresses. Linguistically it belongs to the Arabic tradition and is also used in English, Urdu, Hindi. Parents who choose Hakimah usually hope their child will grow to embody wise, judge and live with faith, good character and purpose.
data.spiritual_meaning: To carry the wisdom of Allah and judge with compassion and fairness.
data.etymology: Hakimah belongs to the Arabic linguistic tradition and is used in Islamic naming. Its recorded meaning is “Wise, Judge.”
data.numerology_meaning: In Pythagorean numerology the letters of Hakimah total 6, giving a life-path number of 6. Number 6 is linked with Venus and with the qualities of responsibility, care and community.

in_arabic.name: حكيمة
in_arabic.meaning: حكيمة تعني الحكماء والذكية في الدين والدنيا
in_arabic.long_meaning: حكيمة هي اسم علم مؤنث من أصل عربي، مشتق من كلمة الحكم، وتعني الشخصية الحكيمة والذكية التي تتمتع بالفهم العميق للدين والدنيا. وردت هذه الكلمة في القرآن الكريم في سورة البقرة آية 269: 'والذين آمنوا بالكتاب ورسلنا أولئك هم الشهيد'، وقد وردت كلمة حكيم في القرآن الكريم خمسين مرة، مشيرة إلى صفات الله تعالى. يعتبر اسم حكيمة من الأسماء المحببة في الثقافة الإسلامية، حيث يعكس صفات الحكمة والذكاء.

in_urdu.name: حکیمہ
in_urdu.meaning: حکیمہ یعنی دانائی والا اور ذہین
in_urdu.long_meaning: حکیمہ ایک علم کا اسم ہے جو عربی زبان سے ماخوذ ہے۔ اس کا مطلب ہے دانائی والا اور ذہین۔ یہ نام اسلامی ثقافت میں بہت اہمیت رکھتا ہے کیونکہ یہ حکمت اور ذہانت کی علامت ہے۔ عربی زبان میں اس کا جڑ الفاظ 'حکمت' سے ماخوذ ہے جس کا مطلب ہے حکمت یا دانائی۔ اسلامی روایت میں حکیمہ ان نساء کی صفت ہے جو حکمت و دانائی کی مالک ہوتی ہیں۔

in_hindi.name: हकीमा
in_hindi.long_meaning: हकीमा एक नाम है जो अरबी भाषा से लिया गया है। इसका अर्थ है बुद्धिमान और समझदार। यह नाम इस्लामी संस्कृति में बहुत महत्व रखता है क्योंकि यह बुद्धिमत्ता और समझदारी का प्रतीक है। अरबी भाषा में इसके मूल शब्द 'हिकमत' से लिया गया है जिसका अर्थ है बुद्धिमत्ता या ज्ञान। इस्लामी परंपरा में हकीमा उन महिलाओं की विशेषता है जो बुद्धिमत्ता और समझदारी की मालक होती हैं।

in_pashto.name: حکيمة
in_pashto.meaning: حکيمة د داناۍ او پوهاوي معنی ورکوي
in_pashto.long_meaning: حکيمة د ښځو يو نوم دی چې د عربي ژبې څخه اخيستل شوی دی. د دې نوم مطلب داناۍ او پوهاوي څخه عبارت دی. دا نوم د افغانستان او پاکستان د پښتنو قومونو په کلتور کې ډیر اهميت لري. د پښتو ژبې ولسمشرۍ داسې وايي چې حکيمة د عربي کلمې 'حکمت' څخه اخیستل شوی دی، چې معنی یې داناۍ او حکمت دی.

in_english.name: Hakimah
in_english.meaning: Wisdom, intelligent and discerning in religion and worldly affairs
in_english.long_meaning: Hakimah is a feminine given name of Arabic origin, derived from the word 'hukm', meaning wisdom or intelligent. In Islamic tradition, Hakimah signifies a wise and discerning individual, particularly in matters of religion and worldly affairs. The name Hakimah appears in various forms throughout the Quran, often associated with attributes of wisdom and knowledge. Historically, the name Hakimah has been used to describe women of great intellect and spiritual insight. In contemporary Muslim cultures, Hakimah remains a popular name, symbolizing the values of wisdom, intelligence, and spiritual growth.

data.cultural_impact: The name Hakimah carries a significant cultural impact as it is a title of high esteem and respect for a woman who is wise and knowledgeable. In many Middle Eastern and Muslim communities, a woman bearing this name is considered a role model and a source of wisdom and guidance. It reflects the value placed on knowledge and wisdom in these cultures, especially for women who were traditionally denied access to education and opportunities for learning. The name Hakimah signifies intelligence, knowledge, and the ability to provide wise counsel and make sound judgments, which are highly valued qualities in any society.
data.spiritual_significance: From a spiritual perspective, the name Hakimah holds great significance as it is a reminder of the importance of knowledge and wisdom in the pursuit of spiritual growth and enlightenment. The Prophet Muhammad (peace be upon him) once said, "The best of you is the one who learns, and the best of what he learns is the knowledge of Allah and His Prophet, and the most virtuous of you is the one who is most beneficial to the people." (Sahih Muslim) The name Hakimah inspires one to seek knowledge and wisdom not only for personal growth but also to be of service to others. It is a reminder of the importance of acquiring knowledge and using it in a noble and beneficial manner, in accordance with Islamic values and teachings. Ultimately, the name Hakimah reflects the Islamic ideal of living a life guided by wisdom, knowledge, and a deep awareness of Allah's presence and guidance.
